purpose: Prevent exact registration-decision idempotency replays from exposing notification delivery metadata a second time.
requiredInvariants: The first authorized decision result can expose one notification delivery payload.
An exact idempotency replay returns replayed=true and omits notification delivery metadata.
Reusing an idempotency key for another application remains a conflict.
Both platform-reviewer and organization-administrator decision paths share the replay-safe boundary.
The follow-up branch cannot edit this scope contract, its checker, or the protected guard workflow.
